<description>
I think it is clear that devs are not following the clang-format config here even in new code, and I don't want to rub this in during review, nor do I want to see clang-format edit those when I use it locally.

So relax the config to allow those.

References:

https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ClangFormatStyleOptions.html#allowshortloopsonasingleline:

```
git grep --line-number --perl-regexp '^\s*for \([^)]+\) [^{]+;$' ./src/ | wc -l
-> 111
```

https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ClangFormatStyleOptions.html#alwaysbreaktemplatedeclarations:

```
git grep --line-number --perl-regexp '^\s*template\s*<.*>\s*(?:class|struct|[A-Za-z_])' | wc -l
-> 162
```
</description>
